run_mrp_info_cli: run the mrp info CLI command to print system state and defined processes as JSON
review_cli_command: review the mrp info CLI command that displays system state and process definitions using Click
summarize_system_state_output: summarize the mrp system state output showing process ask, state, return code, and error info
review_defined_processes_output: review the mrp defined processes output showing process name, root, rule file, runtime, cfg, deps, and env
refactor_cli_command: refactor the mrp info CLI command to add filtering or formatting options for system state output
